audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls this EVEN at 6/10. Emerald+ is 43.79% over 1167 games — the worst in the slice by a clear margin.
audit.why: 43.79% over 1167 games is not an even lane, and the page's own text agrees with the win rate rather than with the label: the chart gives Ornn four of the seven stages, `late` says 'this is where Ornn just wins', and the spikes describe a champion who out-itemises Jayce without recalling. EVEN 6/10 is the only string on the page claiming otherwise. I have not changed it here because the mirror page ornn__jayce.json does not exist yet and setting Jayce to HARD without the matching easy rating on Ornn's side would create the exact contradiction mirror-fix.js exists to catch — flagged in questionsForUser instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in this matchup, and it is right — not one number appears in any of the four spikes, three paragraphs or seven whys.
audit.why: Ornn's threat is a two-ability combo with two very different cooldowns: Volcanic Rupture is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7 at 800 range and Searing Charge is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 at 450. The pillar is cheap and constant; the charge into it is the expensive half. So the sequencing rule is not 'avoid the combo', it is 'the pillar being down means nothing, the charge being down means you can step up for fourteen seconds'. Bellows Breath is 12s and Call of the Forge God 140s at rank 1. Without those the page can only tell the player to be careful forever.
audit.corrected: Searing Charge 14s at rank 1 is the window; Volcanic Rupture is only 9s and comes back constantly.

audit.whatIsWrong: `wants.you[1]` and `whys[1]` both say the armour/MR shred lands 'on the first hit after each R toggle'. Only one of the two toggles shreds.
audit.why: Riot: from Hammer Stance the swap becomes Mercury Cannon and 'the first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist'; from Cannon Stance it becomes Mercury Hammer and that first attack 'deals additional magic damage'. So half of the toggles the page credits with shred do not shred. Against Ornn this is the most valuable button on the bar — Living Forge gives him bonus Armor and MR from all sources, so he is the champion whose resistances most need stripping — and a player alternating toggles expecting shred on both gets it on half of them.
audit.corrected: Only the swap INTO Mercury Cannon shreds; the Hammer-form first hit is bonus magic damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Living Forge is described only as free itemisation without recalling. Riot's first sentence about it is missing entirely.
audit.why: Riot's text opens: 'Ornn gains an additional bonus Armor and Magic Resist from all sources.' That is a multiplier on every defensive stat he buys, not just convenience — it means the gold-efficiency argument the page makes ('the gold you bled out of him does not translate') is understating it, and it makes the Mercury Cannon shred and magic penetration worth more here than in any other tank matchup, because you are stripping an amplified number. The page's own `dosFull` says 'Build magic pen' without ever explaining why.
audit.corrected: Living Forge amplifies every point of Armor and MR he gains from any source — which is why the Cannon shred and magic pen are the priority here.

audit.why: The Q-pillar-into-E-knockup description is accurate: Volcanic Rupture leaves a magma pillar after a delay, and Searing Charge 'creates a shockwave... which deals damage and knocks up' when Ornn collides with terrain. The pillar is terrain, so the combo works as described, and Call of the Forge God's re-activation for a second knockup is also in Riot's text.

edits.after: Cannon Q fired through your E gate out-ranges Ornn's whole kit, and swapping INTO Mercury Cannon shreds his armor/MR on that first attack. Chunk every step-up inside Searing Charge's 14 seconds at rank 1, before Bellows Breath exists to trade back.

edits.after: - Searing Charge: 14s at rank 1, 450 range — this is the window, not the pillar. - Volcanic Rupture: only 9s, so it is back constantly and cannot hurt you alone. - Call of the Forge God: 140s, re-activating double-knocks.

notes: The packet flagged `wants.you[2]` 'Use Thundering Blow' and `whys[4]` 'His Living Forge' as probable wrong names — both false positives, the names are exact and the checker caught the leading verb and pronoun.
